summary: Tested change-password feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_change_password.py with 7 pytest tests covering auth required, wrong current, policy violations (too short / no number / no letter), same-as-current, and happy path (cookies cleared, old pwd fails, new pwd works). All 7 pass. Frontend: Playwright script drove /login -> dashboard -> change-password card. Verified all required data-testids, empty/mismatch/weak client-side validation messages, server-side wrong-current error, success message, forced logout + redirect to /login, OLD password fails to login, NEW password logs in, then restored back to original. No password values or bcrypt hashes leaked in API bodies or DOM. Manager and admin accounts confirmed restored (login 200 for both).
critical_code_review_comments: ChangePasswordCard: on success it clears fields and calls logout after 1600ms via setTimeout. If the user navigates away or the component unmounts before the timeout fires (e.g., closes modal), the timeout is not cleared -- minor cleanup nit; consider useRef+clearTimeout in a useEffect cleanup.

apiClient response interceptor treats /auth/change-password as a non-auth call (isAuthCall only checks login/refresh/logout). If change-password ever returns 401 (e.g. cookie expired mid-request), the interceptor will silently attempt /auth/refresh and retry, which is fine but slightly obscures the UX; consider adding change-password to isAuthCall for clarity.
Backend change_password does not enforce a max length on new_password; extremely long inputs (>72 bytes) will be silently truncated by bcrypt. Consider validating length <= 72 or documenting.
